events.factual_description: The New York Philharmonic presents Yo-Yo Ma with Gustavo Dudamel and the Orchestra on Friday, October 2, 2026, at Wu Tsai Theater, David Geffen Hall. The official Philharmonic page lists a one-hour program without intermission: Tania León's Imágenes mestizas, a New York Philharmonic commission; the Adagietto from Mahler's Symphony No. 5; and Osvaldo Golijov's Azul for cello and orchestra, with Ma as cello soloist and Dudamel conducting. Yo-Yo Ma's official calendar independently confirms the October 2 New York engagement and links back to the Philharmonic. Ticketmaster's authorized David Geffen Hall listing and Apple Music's concert listing both publish a 7:30 PM curtain. Apple Music also verifies Ma's 2016 recording Golijov: Azul with The Knights and Eric Jacobsen. No stable face-value ticket price was verified in the authoritative static sources checked, so none is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: Ma is not dropping in for a generic star turn: the centerpiece is Golijov's Azul, a work he has already made part of his recorded language, now placed inside Dudamel's first month leading the New York Philharmonic. With León's Imágenes mestizas and Mahler's Adagietto compressed into the same one-hour arc, the night puts cello color, Latin American orchestral imagination and Dudamel's new institutional chapter in unusually direct conversation.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play, actively make room for this and let David Geffen Hall anchor the evening. From the DMV, I would pair it with a broader New York day rather than build a dedicated up-and-back trip solely around this one-hour program.

es.why_it_matters: Ma no llega para hacer una aparición de figura invitada sin más: el centro de la noche es Azul de Golijov, una obra que ya forma parte de su lenguaje grabado, ahora colocada dentro del primer mes de Dudamel al frente de la New York Philharmonic. Con Imágenes mestizas de León y el Adagietto de Mahler dentro del mismo arco de una hora, la función pone en conversación directa el color del chelo, la imaginación orquestal latinoamericana y el nuevo capítulo institucional de Dudamel.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya entra en el plan, sí le haría espacio activamente y dejaría que David Geffen Hall ancle la noche. Desde el DMV la combinaría con un día más amplio en Nueva York en vez de armar un viaje de ida y vuelta exclusivamente alrededor de este programa de una hora.
